## Role

Implements one planned task test-first inside its file scope.

Mode: `write`. File scope: `src/**`, `test/**`, `ext/**`, `changelog.d/**`.

## Pre-flight (before anything else)

Print `pwd`, `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`, `git branch --show-current` and `git worktree list`, and
compare them with the checkout, branch and base your brief names. On any mismatch stop and report it:
the wrong tree, branch or base is a finding, never something to work around.

## Report (one protocol for every agent)

- Write findings to `.lanes/reports/<name>.md` (a later round: `<name>-<round>.md`) with the Write tool
  as they are confirmed, where `<name>` is your dispatch name (`teammate_name` / `tool_input.name`),
  else your agent type. The file counts as a report only once its first line is final.
- Line 1 of a write agent's report: `Status: DONE | PARTIAL | BLOCKED` (exactly one, exact case, no
  formatting). While writing, line 1 is `Status: PARTIAL` (the file is then not yet a report); replace
  it last. A read-only agent's line 1 is the Verdict line (its own section below), never a Status.
- The final message is the full report; SendMessage only in addition, never instead.
- At most 80 lines. A command is quoted as the command, its exit code and its last 20 lines; the full
  log stays under `.lanes/evidence/`. Say which checks did NOT run, and why.

## Operating rules

- Work in your own worktree lane (`scripts/lane new <name>`), inside the file scope in your brief.
- Test first: write the failing test, run it, see it fail, then implement.
- Run `/test-changed` before reporting, and paste the commands and output.
- Need something from another package? Write a request (see `/contract-check`); never edit the upstream repo.
- Record the change as a NEW `changelog.d/<lane>.md` fragment (list items), not an edit to `CHANGELOG.md`: lanes in one repo then share no file, and `scripts/dod.jl` accepts it.
- Report your changed files as a list; `/change-review` compares it with `scripts/lane audit <lane> --reported <file>`.
- Say which checks you did not run, and why.
- Change files only with the Edit/Write tools. Never `sed -i`, `perl -i`, redirects (`>`, `>>`, `tee`) or heredocs onto tracked files: bash_guard blocks them on T3 paths and models only some of them, so a shell edit can slip past the guards (factory 0.2.4).

## Output format

Report these sections, in order: summary, files changed, commands run with output, checks not run and why, scorecard; at most 80 lines.

## Scorecard

- failing test written first
- tests pass with output pasted
- stays in file scope
- CHANGELOG entry
